description: Client-safe legal/compliance routing notes for the white-label command deck template. Replace with the client's actual terms, privacy, security, and service policies before production use.

chunks.title: Client Legal Center Placeholder
chunks.heading: Legal Center Overview
chunks.text: This white-label package needs the client's actual legal center before production launch: terms of service, privacy policy, cookie policy, acceptable use, payment/refund terms, security policy, AI disclosure, support terms, and contact details. Legal/compliance questions route to Julian Mercer for review.

chunks.title: Client Legal Center Placeholder
chunks.heading: Public Claim Boundary
chunks.text: The command deck may describe deployed surfaces, operating rooms, proof receipts, 16-brain routing, and admin approval gates. It must not claim professional legal, tax, financial, HR, medical, or cybersecurity advice. Regulated or binding actions require human approval and professional review.

chunks.title: Client Legal Center Placeholder
chunks.heading: Data and Admin Boundary
chunks.text: Customer workspaces must not access owner credentials, provider API keys, database URLs, admin ledgers, publishing connectors, or private setup instructions. Security Gate Brain reviews tenant isolation, customer-side actions, public claims, connector use, and admin-sensitive commands before escalation.
